scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write src scripts config *.json *.ts index.html
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && tsc --noEmit && oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error src scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts && node scripts/guardrails.mjs && node scripts/check-contracts.mjs
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --locked && vitest run --passWithNoTests && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:quality
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run coverage && npm run test:guardrails && node scripts/secrets.mjs && cargo deny check && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.release: MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=27.0 tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs
